creator: opichillc
title: Vercel breach alert: attackers entered via a compromised third-party AI tool ('Context AI') on an employee's Google Workspace; non-'sensitive' env vars were readable, so rotate keys, flag all secrets sensitive, audit logs

tools.name: Context AI
tools.detail: third-party AI tool an employee connected to a work Google account; the compromise vector

tools.name: Stripe / OpenAI / Supabase / AWS
tools.detail: providers where you must regenerate keys

claims: Vector: employee connected Context AI to their work Google account; attackers compromised Context AI, hijacked the Google Workspace, got into Vercel's internal systems and environment variables
Env vars not marked 'sensitive' were stored in a readable way; many users never toggled it
how_to_steps: Log into Vercel and check environment variables across every project
Any API keys, DB credentials or tokens not marked sensitive: rotate them immediately at the source (Stripe, OpenAI, Supabase, AWS)
Turn on the 'sensitive' flag for every secret going forward
Check provider activity logs and recent deployments for unrecognized activity
on_screen_only: Caption-only talking head; no UI shown
cta: Comment 'done'; link in bio to book a setup check

relevance.why: Haji's apps are vibe-coded and likely on Vercel; the liked set has 'should you host on Vercel' and vibe-coded security holes but not this incident or the sensitive-env-var flag

implement_score.why: Half-hour action: audit every Vercel project's env vars, flip sensitive on all secrets, rotate anything that was plain, review deployment/activity logs. Also a general lesson: third-party AI tools connected to Google Workspace are an attack surface

verify: Confirm the actual Vercel security incident, date, and scope (which env vars were exposed, which customers)
Exact name of the third-party tool (transcript says 'Context AI')
Whether Vercel now defaults new env vars to sensitive

gap.what: A specific incident warning and the Vercel 'sensitive' env-var flag / key-rotation checklist; liked set covered general vibe-code security but not supply-chain breach via an AI SaaS connected to Workspace
